text:
Anya: Quick reality check — are we confident on the SLA numbers we want to commit for GA? I want concrete values to put in the contracts by EOD.
Cam: My preference: 99.9% monthly uptime, p95 gen latency < 300ms for standard tier, p95 < 120ms for dedicated.
Mike: Agree on thresholds but we need clear exclusion clauses for infra incidents + planned maintenance windows.
Priya: Ops asks: what does 'monthly uptime' mean for multi-region failover? We should call out regional SLOs vs global.
Anya: Good call. Draft proposal: global availability 99.9% (regional 99.5%); planned maintenance not counted if >48h notice. Thoughts?
Cam: Fine. Also add SLA credits formula: 5% monthly credit if below global, 10% if repeated within trailing 3 months. Keep simple.
Mike: Can someone confirm monitoring/alerting coverage before we freeze numbers? We need playbooks and alert runbooks linked.
Priya: Ops checklist (short):
- alerts for p50/p95/p99 latency
- 4xx/5xx error rate thresholds
- token-spike detection
- autoscale fail alerts
Cam: I'll pair with infra to ensure dashboards exist. Assign to me: create p95 latency dashboard + dashboard link.
Anya: Docs question — do we expose the exact SLA math in customer-facing docs or keep in contract only?
Priya: Contract only; public doc should summarize guarantees and link to support for details.
Mike: Support readiness: 24/7 oncall for first 30 days GA with runbook for model-quality regressions and fallback routing to smaller models. Who owns runbook?
Anya: Priya to own support playbook, Cam to own rollback/fallback tech steps.
Priya: Happy to own playbook. I'll draft and put in /docs/playbooks/ and ping here. ETA: tomorrow noon.
Cam: DeployBot: can we run the staged failover test tonight at 11pm PST?
DeployBot: scheduled failover test queued for 2024-05-01T23:00:00Z — will post results to #eng-oncall.
Mike: Pricing readiness: need to confirm per-token unit costs and dedicated reservation uplift before commercial. Who's finalizing numbers?
Anya: Finance sent a baseline. Cam, meet with Finops to lock committed pricing by EOD tomorrow.
Cam: On it. Also need billing test plan — invoice samples, metering checks.
Priya: Support training: propose 60-min lunch-and-learn + tabletop incident runbook on day -3. Volunteers?
Mike: I'll join the tabletop and own incident triage section.
Anya: Final gating checklist for us to sign off (short):
- SLA wording agreed and in contract (owner: Anya)
- Monitoring dashboards live + runbooks linked (owner: Cam/Priya)
- Support rota and training scheduled (owner: Priya)
- Pricing and billing tests passed (owner: Cam/Finance)
- Public docs: short SLA summary + links to contact support (owner: DocsBot)
DocsBot: Created doc stub at /docs/ga/sla-summary.md — needs content.
Cam: I'll drop dashboard links and billing test checklist into the doc stub when ready.
Anya: If everyone hits their owners, we can lock the public-facing comms tomorrow afternoon. Please add any blockers now. :thumbsup:
Mike: Potential blocker: loadtest earlier this week showed a memory leak at sustained 2x expected QPS. Devs have a PR but we need verification. Recommend holding final signoff until leak is validated fixed in canary.
Cam: Noted — will pause on final signoff until leak fix is validated in canary. Running canary verification tomorrow AM.
Priya: Ops will standby for canary watch.
Anya: OK — new small action: Mike to confirm leak fix + canary pass by 12:00 tomorrow, Cam to post verification, Priya to confirm alerts behave. If green we'll proceed with SLA wording and docs.
Mike: Will update here when done.
Anya: Thanks everyone — concise owners and next steps. We'll reconvene if any of those items slip. :rocket:
